Santa Rosa Beach House on 30A by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Santa Rosa Beach House on 30A! This stunning 3 bedroom, 3 bath home is in the quiet, gated community of Cypress Dunes, where you can see deer and other wildlife during early evening walks along the boardwalks and trails. The well-preserved Topsail State Park is nearby and can be observed from all three stories of Santa Rosa Beach House on 30A. In addition, you’ll have access to two community pools and a fitness center. Enjoy the pond, in the heart of the community, which includes cypress trees and lily pads, perfect for a peaceful stroll around this quiet neighborhood. The first floor features a cozy sitting area, complete with a desk and chair, as well as a guest room, queen, with a private ensuite bathroom. A second guest room, full, includes a Jack and Jill bathroom that leads back into the sitting area. On the second floor, a fully equipped kitchen, dining room, and large living room are great for gathering and making new fun-filled memories.

The second-floor balcony has incredible views of the Gulf. Can you hear the waves crashing onto the shore? The third floor is dedicated to the private primary bedroom suite, king, complete with a huge ensuite bathroom. Relax in the luxurious Jacuzzi bathtub, gaze at the stars through the large telescope, or step out onto the balcony and take in the views and sounds of the Gulf and The Topsail State Park. Come and experience the ultimate in nature and relaxation at this gorgeous vacation rental. Book your stay at Santa Rosa Beach House on 30A today! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 1.2 miles from the beach (Beach Highlands Access) - 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 2608 sq ft - Reading nook/work area - Wine Cooler - Natural gas grill - Community pools and fitness center access - 6 wristbands - 4 bikes included Overnight: - Queen in 1st floor guest room; private bath; TV - Full in 1st floor guest bedroom; Jack and Jill bath; TV - Half bath in 2nd-floor hallway - King in 3rd floor primary bedroom; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
